AI Automation Engineer (Multiple Levels) — Talent Community
Vortexa Global Solutions · Location: Flexible / Various

Are you passionate about AI? Join our Talent Community!

Vortexa Global Solutions is always looking for exceptional AI talent to join our growing family. This is an evergreen requisition: we accept applications on a rolling basis for current and future openings across our portfolio of clients and internal initiatives.

In this role you may:
- Work on cutting-edge agentic AI and automation solutions
- Collaborate with world-class teams on exciting projects
- Leverage the latest technologies such as LLMs, agents, orchestration frameworks and more
- Drive innovation and deliver value to stakeholders

Ideal candidates will have:
- Experience with AI/ML (any level)
- Passion for technology and a growth mindset
- Excellent communication skills
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

Why join us?
- Competitive compensation
- Exciting career growth opportunities
- A culture of innovation

Please note: submitting an application does not guarantee that a position is currently available. Qualified candidates will be contacted when a suitable opportunity arises. This posting has been open since January 2025 and is refreshed periodically.
